description: Realm-specific flavor: every line names its realm (Albion, Midgard or Hibernia) and may mention that realm's own places, people and pride.

lines.text: Another grey day in Albion. Perfect weather for hunting.
Hadrian's Wall is quiet tonight. Too quiet.
Albion answers the call. For Camelot!
Jordheim is busy today. The smiths never stop hammering.
For Midgard! Let the walls of {keep} hear our war cry!
Cold wind off the mountains. Good for the blood.
Tir na Nog is lovely this time of day. A shame to leave it.
Hold {keep} for Hibernia! Not one step back!
Emain Macha is restless. Watch the treeline.
Smell that? Avalon Marsh is in bloom again. Or rotting. Hard to tell.
I miss the bread in Cotswold. Nobody bakes like that out in the wilds.
Every time I pass Stonehenge I swear the stones have moved.
Some say Arthur will return when Albion needs him most. I hope he hurries.
Quiet day. Even the bandits on Salisbury Plains seem to be napping.
Heard the Black Mountains are restless lately. Might go and see for myself.
Thinking of heading to {destination}. The roads of Albion are kind enough today.
Aye, Albion has seen far worse days than this.
Keep your blade oiled anyway. Albion never stays quiet for long.
Camelot never sleeps. Someone is always shouting near the bank.
The trainers in Camelot have been grumpy all week.
Picked up this {item} in Ludlow. It will do for now.
Humberton smells of horses and ale. I love it.
Prydwen Keep is a fine place to rest before heading into Lyonesse.
Bored guards in Camelot. That is the best kind of guard.
Caer Gothwaite is pretty, but it is no Camelot.
Aye, and the merchants of Camelot still charge too much.
Camelot's taverns will still be here when you get back.
Off down the old road toward Cornwall. Wish me luck.
Taking the horse route out of Camelot. My feet thank the stablemaster.
Heading for {destination}. Albion is bigger than it looks on the map.
The fog over Llyn Barfog always gives me the shivers.
Mind Campacorentin Forest after dark. Things move in those trees.
Crossing Salisbury Plains again. So much grass, so few landmarks.
Lyonesse is a long walk, but the old ruins are worth seeing.
Safe travels. The roads of Albion are not what they used to be.
Wave to the guards at Ludlow for me.
Pennine Mountains are clear so far. Keep moving.
Patrolling past Caer Benowyc. Nothing out here but crows.
Forest Sauvage is too still. That is where they like to hide.
Castle Sauvage has its gates shut tight. Good.
Snowdonia is bitter cold tonight. Stay near the fortress walls.
{guild} is holding the road past the milegate. Shout if you see green or blue.
Right behind you. Albion watches the Wall together.
Fresh tracks near the Wall. Could be Hibs, could be deer.
Rams forward! Albion takes {keep} today!
For Camelot! Bring that door down!
Archers on their wall, Albion. Keep your shields high.
This keep will fly the red of Albion before nightfall.
Wizards ready, trebuchets loosing. Let us show {enemyrealm} how Albion sieges.
Clerics, keep those armsmen standing. The door is nearly through.
Camelot's minstrels will sing about {keep} tonight.
Holding the ram line. For Albion!
With you. Albion does not retreat.
To the walls! {enemyrealm} is at the gate of {keep}!
Albion holds this keep. They will break on our stones.
Boiling oil ready? Good. Let them come for Albion.
Every Albion in range, get to {keep} now!
Hold the inner door. Camelot is counting on us.
Someone repair that door. I will hold the stairs for Albion.
Not one stone of this keep goes to {enemyrealm}.
On my way to the walls. For Albion!
Holding the lord's room. No {enemyrealm} gets past me.
{keep} is ours! Raise the banner of Albion!
Victory for Camelot! Drinks are on someone else.
That will teach {enemyrealm} to test Albion.
Albion stands! Somebody tell the town criers in Camelot.
Well fought, everyone. The walls of Albion grew a little taller today.
Back to Camelot with a story worth telling.
Red banners over {keep}. What a sight.
Gratz all. Long live Albion!
Aye, good work. Albion earned this one.
Albion, gather up! {raid} is forming and we need every blade.
Calling all of Camelot for {raid}. Bring potions and courage.
Clerics and friars, we need you most of all. Form up for Albion!
Who is coming? Albion has a beast to hunt.
Meet at the gates of Camelot, then we march.
{guild} stands ready for Albion. Just point us at it.
Count me in. Albion never misses a good hunt.
On my way. Saving a spot near the clerics.
The beast is down! Glory to Albion!
{raid} is done. Camelot's minstrels will be busy for weeks.
When Albion stands together, nothing can stop it.
What a fight. I need a week in a Cotswold inn.
Hang that trophy in Camelot where everyone can see it.
Legend says Golestandt watches from Dartmoor. Let him hear about this.
Another legend for Albion. Well done, all.
Gratz everyone! Albion stands tall today.
Well fought. Camelot will hear of this.
Albion, hold the keep in {bg}! Do not let them flank us!
Young blood of Albion, show them what Camelot trains!
Every flag in {bg} should be Albion red by nightfall.
Stick together, Albion. Battlegrounds reward the patient.
Good practice for Hadrian's Wall someday, this place.
Mids and Hibs both? Fine. Albion takes on all comers.
{guild} has the high ground in {bg}. Albion, rally to us.
With you, Albion. Push the keep!
Holding the flank for Albion. Go!
Ding {level}! Camelot would be proud.
Level {level} at last. Albion gets one more seasoned {class}.
{level}! Off to see my trainer in Camelot.
Another level for Albion. My legs ache from all this walking.
That one took ages. Hadrian's Wall, here I come.
{level} now. Maybe the Mids will take me seriously.
Ding {level}. The Tomb of Mithra no longer scares me. Much.
Grats! Albion grows stronger every day.
Well done. Your trainer in Camelot will be glad to see you.
Odin watches. Best not slack off where he can see.
Snow again over Vasudheim. My beard has frost in it.
Nothing like a horn of mead after a long day of hunting.
My grandfather fought trolls in the Jamtland Mountains. Or so he says.
The kobolds of Mularn could teach the Albs a thing or two about trade.
Quiet day in Midgard. I almost miss the Hibs.
Thinking of {destination}. The roads of Midgard are hard but honest.
Aye. Midgard is never quiet for long.
Skal to that, friend.
Jordheim's halls are warm tonight. Stay a while.
The bankers of Jordheim count slower than a sleepy dwarf.
Got this {item} from a trader in Audliten. Decent work.
Haggerfel is small, but the ale there is honest.
Aegirhamn smells of salt and fish. Not complaining.
Every time I visit Jordheim I get lost in those great halls.
Huginfel has the last good bed before the wilds.
Aye, and the trainers of Jordheim still shout too loud.
Grab a hot meal in Jordheim before you head out.
Heading through Myrkwood. Watch for wolves.
Taking the long road to Svealand. My feet already hate me.
Off to {destination}. The hills of Midgard never end.
Crossing Raumarik. Snow up to my knees.
The Vale of Mularn looks so small from up on the ridge.
Malmohus is cold enough to freeze your thoughts.
Muspelheim ahead. Bring water and patience.
Safe travels. Keep your axe close in Midgard's wilds.
Odin guide your steps.
Odin's Gate is calm. Keep your eyes on the ridge.
Uppland is quiet. I do not trust it one bit.
Patrolling near Svasud Faste. All clear for now.
Yggdra Forest is thick tonight. Easy place for an Alb to hide.
Fresh prints in the snow near Odin's Gate. Somebody passed through.
{guild} holds the road to Svasud Faste. Shout if you see red or green.
With you. Midgard watches the gate.
Nothing on my side of the ridge. Keep moving, Midgard.
Bring the ram! Midgard knocks on {keep}!
Thor's thunder on their walls! Push!
Runemasters, light up those battlements for Midgard!
Their door is cracking. Midgard, one more push!
Skalds, sing us through that gate!
{enemyrealm} built these walls. Midgard will take them down.
Valhalla waits for anyone who falls at {keep}. Charge!
For Midgard! I am on the ram!
Right beside you with axe in hand. For Odin!
To the walls, Midgard! {keep} needs us!
They come for {keep}? Let them break on Midgard stone.
Healers on the wall, warriors at the door. Hold for Midgard!
Not today, {enemyrealm}. Not while Midgard stands.
Every son and daughter of Midgard, get to {keep}!
Pour the oil. Midgard does not yield.
The gods are watching {keep}. Make them proud.
Coming! Hold the door for Midgard!
On the wall now. They will not pass while Odin watches.
{keep} is ours! Raise the blue banners!
Skal! Midgard wins the day!
Odin smiles on us today.
Back to Jordheim with tales to tell.
That is how Midgard fights. Well done, all.
Pour the mead, Midgard. We earned it.
Let {enemyrealm} remember this day at {keep}.
Gratz, Midgard! Skal!
Well fought, brothers and sisters of the north.
Midgard, gather! {raid} is forming!
Who will hunt with me? Glory awaits the sons of Midgard.
Healers and shamans, step up. Midgard needs you.
Meet at the gates of Jordheim. We march soon.
For Odin and for Midgard! Join {raid}!
Bring your best axes and your strongest mead.
Even Gjalpinulva would think twice if she saw us gathered.
Count me in. My axe is thirsty.
On my way, friend. Save me a spot by the skalds.
The beast falls! Skal, Midgard!
{raid} is done. The skalds will sing of it for a week.
Odin was watching that one.
Midgard stands as one, and nothing stands before us.
Mead for everyone in Jordheim tonight!
A tale fit for the great halls of Jordheim.
My shield arm is numb. Worth every blow for Midgard.
Gratz all! Midgard is mighty!
Skal! That is how the north fights.
Midgard, take the keep in {bg}!
Young warriors of Midgard, show them your steel!
Blue banners on every flag in {bg}. Make it happen.
Stick close, Midgard. Pick them apart one at a time.
Good practice for Odin's Gate, this place.
Albs on the left, Hibs on the right. Perfect.
{guild} has the keep in {bg}. Come help us hold it, Midgard.
With you! For Midgard!
Pushing up the hill. Follow me, Midgard.
Ding {level}! Odin be praised!
Level {level}. One step closer to Valhalla.
{level}! Off to the trainers in Jordheim.
Midgard has one more {class} to count on. Ding!
Another level. I will drink to that in Jordheim tonight.
Ding {level}. Spindelhalla, here I come.
{level} at last. Even the trolls of Myrkwood look smaller now.
Gratz! Skal!
Well done. Midgard is proud of you.
The air in Hibernia always smells of rain and clover.
Saw something with glowing eyes near Ardee. I left quickly.
Lough Derg is lovely in the evening mist.
A quiet day in Hibernia. The bards will have nothing to write.
Sometimes I just sit by the Shannon Estuary and listen.
Thinking of heading to {destination}. Hibernia has so many paths.
Lugh's light on all of us today.
Aye, Hibernia is beautiful when it is peaceful.
Enjoy it while it lasts. The Albs never rest for long.
The market in Tir na Nog is bustling today.
I could get lost in the gardens of Tir na Nog for hours.
Got this {item} in Mag Mell. Fine Lurikeen craftsmanship.
Howth is small, but the people are kind.
Tir na mBeo has the best bread in Hibernia.
The Grove of Domnann is beautiful, if a little strange.
The trainers in Tir na Nog never seem to tire.
Aye, Tir na Nog is the heart of Hibernia.
Rest well. The wilds of Hibernia will wait.
Heading through the Cursed Forest. Wish me luck.
Crossing Lough Gur. The roads are muddy again.
Off to {destination}. The roads of Hibernia wind like a river.
The Silvermine Mountains are steep but beautiful.
Through the Valley of Bri Leith. Mind the shadows.
Cliffs of Moher ahead. Do not look down.
Taking the horse out of Tir na Nog. My boots need a rest.
Safe travels, friend. May the paths of Hibernia be kind.
Watch the treeline. The forests of Hibernia have eyes.
Patrolling Cruachan Gorge. All quiet.
Breifine is too still. Stay alert.
Mount Collory has fog rolling in. Easy cover for Mids.
Druim Ligen is safe. Moving on.
Eyes sharp, Hibernia. They always come at dusk.
{guild} has the eastern path. Call out if you see blue or red.
Saw a glint of armor near the trees. Probably an Alb.
With you. Hibernia guards her own.
Nothing near the river. Keep the patrol going, Hibernia.
Rams up! Hibernia takes {keep} today!
For Hibernia! Bring the door down!
Eldritches, burn those battlements!
Druids behind the ram line, keep them standing!
Their walls are weak. Hibernia, push!
Let {enemyrealm} hear the bards of Hibernia at their door.
Green banners will fly over {keep} by dusk.
On the ram! For Hibernia!
Right behind you with blade ready. For Lugh!
To the walls, Hibernia! {keep} is under attack!
Hold the line! Hibernia does not yield.
Every child of Hibernia in range, get to {keep}!
Hot oil on the walls! Give them a Hibernian welcome.
Not one step for {enemyrealm}. Not one!
Wardens on the door, druids behind. Hold fast, Hibernia.
The very trees will fight for {keep}.
On my way! Hold the gate for Hibernia!
Holding the lord's room. Hibernia can trust me.
{keep} is ours! Raise the green banners!
Victory for Hibernia! The old gods smile on us.
Tir na Nog will sing of this.
Well fought, all. Hibernia stands.
That is how Hibernia fights. Never forget it.
Back to Tir na Nog for a song and a rest.
Let {enemyrealm} lick their wounds. {keep} stays green.
Gratz, Hibernia! Well fought!
Aye, a fine day for the green.
Hibernia, gather! {raid} is forming!
Who hunts with Hibernia today?
Druids and bards, we need your songs and heals.
Meet at the gates of Tir na Nog.
For Lugh and for Hibernia! Join {raid}!
Bring potions and your bravest friends, Hibernia.
Even Cuuldurach would tremble at this crowd.
Count me in. Hibernia never sits out a hunt.
On my way. Saving a spot by the druids.
The beast is down! Glory to Hibernia!
{raid} is done. Every bard in Tir na Nog has a new song.
Hibernia united cannot be beaten.
What a fight! The old gods were with us, Hibernia.
Somebody carve this day into a standing stone in Connacht.
Hibernia will remember this hunt for a long time.
My arms are shaking. Worth every swing for Hibernia.
Gratz everyone! A fine day for Hibernia.
Well fought. The druids of Hibernia earned their rest.
Hibernia, take the keep in {bg}!
Young heroes of Hibernia, show them your mettle!
Green flags all over {bg}. Make it so.
Stay together, Hibernia. Strength in numbers.
Good practice for Emain Macha, this.
Albs and Mids both? Fine, more for Hibernia.
{guild} is in {bg}. Hibernia, come join us!
With you! For Hibernia!
Holding the flank. Push now, Hibernia!
Ding {level}! Hibernia grows stronger.
Level {level}. Off to the trainers in Tir na Nog.
{level}! Lugh be praised.
Hibernia has one more {class} ready to fight. Ding!
Another level. Time for a song in Tir na Nog.
Ding {level}. Maybe Muire Tomb will not scare me now.
{level} at last. Even the Cursed Forest looks less scary now.
Gratz! Hibernia is proud of you.
Well done, friend. Your trainer in Tir na Nog awaits.
True enough. Still, I would not trade Albion for anywhere else.
Keep the clerics close and the door will fall. For Camelot!
Coming from Snowdonia Fortress. Hold on, Albion!
Armor polished, potions packed. Albion, I am coming.
Ha. Spoken like a true child of the north.
Jordheim always feels like home after a long hunt.
Swinging for Midgard until that door gives way.
Running from Svasud Faste now. Hold them, Midgard!
Well said. There is no land as fair as Hibernia.
Mind the bogs out there. Hibernian mud swallows boots whole.
Coming from Druim Ligen as fast as my legs allow!
Right behind you. Hibernia hunts as one.
